# Projection model wk21 (day 147). S2 conv JUMPED to 63.3%, eff held 137.9/$1k.
# Scaling S2 ads $20k->$40k/d, S2 dev $5k->$12k/d. Tracks S1/S2 billing separately.
def run(eff_s2, conv_s2, conv_drift, churn_s2_wk, s1_new0, s1_new_decay, s1_churn_rate,
        s2_ad_path, label=""):
    cash = 5553524
    S1 = 262688.0; S2 = 18636.0; S3 = 50.0
    s2_pool = 167374.0; s1_pool = 272812.0
    # S2 re-bill/due: ~99% survival * (0.60*26 + 0.40*79) = ~46.7
    s2_rpd = 0.99*(0.60*26 + 0.40*79)
    s1_rpd0 = 22.4  # 88% survival * ~26 blended
    # near-term actual dues (total S1+S2). wk22 buckets sum ~52,959
    dues = [52959, 58605, 75165, 49981]  # wk22..wk25 approx (rebill.py humps)
    horizons = {}
    for wk in range(1, 27):
        s2_ad = s2_ad_path(wk)
        base = S1 + S2 + S3
        # split dues by S1/S2 share
        if wk <= 4:
            due_tot = dues[wk-1]
        else:
            due_tot = base*7/30
        s2_share = S2/base
        s2_due = due_tot*s2_share
        s1_due = due_tot*(1-s2_share)
        s1_rpd = s1_rpd0 - (wk/26.0)*0.8  # slight recession drift
        rebill = s1_due*s1_rpd + s2_due*s2_rpd
        # acquisition
        s2_cap_factor = max(0.15, 1 - S2/(s2_pool*(1+0.00286*wk)))
        s2_leads = s2_ad*7/1000.0*eff_s2*s2_cap_factor
        cv = min(0.75, conv_s2 + conv_drift*wk)
        s2_new = s2_leads*cv
        s2_churn = S2*churn_s2_wk
        s1_new = max(2000, s1_new0*(s1_new_decay**wk))  # cap drag decay
        s1_churn = S1*s1_churn_rate
        # first bills: S2 60/40 A/B, S1 ~97/3
        first = (s1_new*(0.97*15+0.03*68) + s2_new*(0.60*15+0.40*68))
        S1 += s1_new - s1_churn
        S2 += s2_new - s2_churn
        S1 = min(S1, s1_pool*(1+0.00286*wk))
        # costs
        compute = S1*77*0.002*7 + S2*231*0.003342*7 + 3000
        leads_tot = (s1_new/0.70) + s2_leads + 2000
        lead_cost = leads_tot*0.5
        ads = (12000 + s2_ad)*7
        dev = (1500 + 12000)*7
        ops = 322000
        cap = 196000
        costs = ops+cap+dev+ads+lead_cost+compute
        net = rebill+first-costs
        cash += net
        if wk in (1,4,12,26):
            horizons[wk]=(cash,S1,S2,net)
    print(f"\n[{label}] eff={eff_s2} conv0={conv_s2} churn_s2={churn_s2_wk}")
    for h in (1,4,12,26):
        c,s1,s2,net = horizons[h]
        print(f"  {h:2d}wk (d{147+h*7}): cash=${c:,.0f}  S1={s1:,.0f} S2={s2:,.0f} net/wk=${net:,.0f}")
    return horizons

# ad paths
def ramp_base(wk):   # 40->60->80 then hold, taper after saturation
    return min(80000, 40000 + 20000*(wk-1)) if wk<=3 else 80000
def ramp_high(wk):   # aggressive to 120k
    return min(120000, 40000 + 40000*(wk-1))
def ramp_low(wk):    # cautious, cap at 50k
    return min(50000, 40000 + 10000*(wk-1))

print("=== BASE (eff degrades to 125, conv holds 60%, dev lifts +0.4pp/wk) ===")
base = run(eff_s2=125, conv_s2=0.60, conv_drift=0.004, churn_s2_wk=0.006, s1_new0=9000,
           s1_new_decay=0.93, s1_churn_rate=0.029, s2_ad_path=ramp_base, label="BASE")
print("\n=== LOW (lead-mix degrades: eff 90, conv 48 falling, recession churn) ===")
low = run(eff_s2=90, conv_s2=0.48, conv_drift=-0.006, churn_s2_wk=0.015, s1_new0=7000,
          s1_new_decay=0.90, s1_churn_rate=0.033, s2_ad_path=ramp_low, label="LOW")
print("\n=== HIGH (flywheel holds: eff 140, conv 66 rising, scale to 120k) ===")
high = run(eff_s2=140, conv_s2=0.66, conv_drift=0.006, churn_s2_wk=0.003, s1_new0=9500,
           s1_new_decay=0.95, s1_churn_rate=0.027, s2_ad_path=ramp_high, label="HIGH")

print("\n=== SUMMARY (point=BASE, CI=[LOW,HIGH]) ===")
for h in (1,4,12,26):
    print(f"  {h:2d}wk (d{147+h*7}): point=${base[h][0]:,.0f}  low=${low[h][0]:,.0f}  high=${high[h][0]:,.0f}")
